decisions.statement: The folder is named the plural a page type gathers its pages under.
A folder named no page type's plural is refused before anything else is read.
More than one page type gathers its pages under one name.
A page of any of those page types is admitted.
A page of a page type extending one of those page types is admitted too.
A page sits here as a file of its own or in a folder of its own.
Every page here is a part the page above the folder declares.
A folder above holding no page is asked for no part.
A file that is neither a page nor a file beside one is refused.
A file beside a page that page states nowhere is refused.
The files a page in a folder of its own holds are judged where that page is.
Nothing here reads the page type of the folder above.

definition: the shape of a folder gathering one page type's pages under that type's plural
